title: Vmem controls tumorigenesis via bacterially derived butyrate acting on HDAC1

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Vmem controls tumorigenesis via bacterially derived butyrate acting on HDAC1

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Control of oncogene-mediated tumorigenesis by resting membrane potential in Xenopus laevis is mediated by histone deacetylase 1, whose inhibition depends on butyrate produced by native gram-positive bacteria.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Transmembrane voltage potential of somatic cells controls oncogene-mediated tumorigenesis at long-range

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Chernet BT 2014, Transmembrane voltage potential of somatic cells controls oncogene-mediated tumorigenesis at long-range › RESULTS › Changes in Vmem

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Together, these data suggest that the control of tumorigenesis by Vmem is mediated by HDAC1, via butyrate derived from gram-positive bacteria.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Chernet BT, Levin M, “Transmembrane voltage potential of somatic cells controls oncogene-mediated tumorigenesis at long-range”, Oncotarget (2014), doi:10.18632/oncotarget.1935; section “RESULTS › Changes in Vmem”. Scope: Oncogene-injected Xenopus laevis embryos with hyperpolarizing treatments, antibiotic treatments and dominant-negative HDAC1

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2014-tumor-08: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.54

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Existing experiments touch several links but do not measure the mediator chain within the same embryos. They provide suggestive partial tests rather than resolution of the compound mechanism.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Model and test the mediation chain from remote Vmem through bacterial abundance and butyrate concentration to HDAC1 activity and tumor incidence, using intervention-specific measurements at each link. Mediation should disappear when butyrate is restored independently of bacteria.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Alternative HDAC regulators remain possible.

The interventions do not form a complete causal mediation design.

Spatial butyrate and bacterial distributions were not measured.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.8
analysis feasibility: 0.7
discriminating power: 0.4
data adequacy: 0.35
data existence: 0.5

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The mediator claim requires voltage, bacterial butyrate, HDAC1 activity, and tumor incidence in one design. The paper reports related incidence contrasts separately and does not deposit butyrate or acetylation measurements. Biochemical literature on butyrate and HDAC in other systems does not supply this Xenopus chain.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: In the same Xenopus oncogene model, jointly measure remote voltage, butyrate at the prospective tumor site, HDAC1 activity, and tumor incidence under hyperpolarization, antibiotics, and dominant-negative HDAC1. The chain is supported only if incidence tracks butyrate-dependent HDAC1 inhibition downstream of voltage.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The three interventions were not deposited as a single paired dataset that could identify the mediator.

Butyrate concentration in the tadpoles is not a public variable.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.22
operationalizability: 0.62
discriminating power: 0.3
analysis feasibility: 0.3
data existence: 0.3
